{{dablink|For other uses of the words "eye" and "gold," see [[Eye]] and [[Gold]].}}
'''''Sei'cair''''' is a word from the [[Old Tongue]] meaning "the eyes of gold" or "golden eyes."

==Use==
An [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]], [[Feraighin]], calls [[Perrin Aybara]] ''sei'cair'' due to his golden wolf eyes. It is similar to ''[[sei'taer]]'', which means "straight" eyes.

==Background==
Note that ''cair'' means gold. '''Cair'''hien, which is the shortened form of ''Al''''cair''''rahienallen'', means "Hill of the '''Golden '''Dawn".
